catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds one turtlesim/Pose target publication consumed by the posctrl follower. cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 requires linear and angular velocity plus a duration and returns measured distance, heading and a stopped flag, none of which the pinned follower acknowledges. cap.world.step.v1 advances a world and cap.world.reset.v1 resets one, but the clone has no such service or action. The extension preserves the upstream x/y target publication and reports only transmission evidence.

Last gate run 2026-11-05T09:13:03Z, backend fake, report_digest sha256:702543063f6020504becd8d822a8d400f9aa517073765eac27962ca19c9126a8: G1 pass Layout and isolation; G2 pass Lock; G3 pass Strict resolve; G4 pass Provenance; G5 pass Reference; G6 fail Behaviour with G6.ESTOP_FAILED: mhs.safety.estop status failed, MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, the latch stays engaged (estop engaged, expected engaged or software_only); G7 pass Native surface; G8 fail Protocol and surface with G8.CONFORMANCE MHS-Sim CL3 not achieved (level CL1), failing required tests TCAP-003 and SAFE-028, G8.TEST TCAP-003 no observable effect (the two invokes left resource main as the empty object and returned the identical output {submitted: true, confirmed: false}), and G8.TEST SAFE-028 (the e-stop receipt reports safe_state_achieved=false); G9 skip Repository tests (G9.NOT_RUN after the G8 failure). There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 1 RosDriver, mode simulated, device_kind world.sim, risk R2 because the target starts an autonomous mobile-base position controller in the simulated Stage world, above the card's R0 floor. There is no Python native class and no native.py; the card's entry_symbols list is empty, so there was no entry symbol to verify and the card's family-config/RosDriver decision matches the wire interface. The primary control is one x-cap.viviancremerkalempa.target_pose.v1 invoke action that publishes one turtlesim/Pose message on /robot_0, the target Topic that PositionController::subCallback consumes. It maps the caller's x and y into the Pose fields; theta is not an operator input because the follower computes its heading with atan2 from the target direction and never reads msg->theta (src/PositionController.cpp:56-57). The generated launch starts posctrl with the node argument robot_0 (launch/controller.launch:7), MainController builds the topic /robot_<i> and advertises turtlesim::Pose on it with queue 1000 (src/MainController.cpp:28-32), PositionController subscribes to /<nodeName> and publishes geometry_msgs/Twist on /<nodeName>/cmd_vel (src/PositionController.cpp:33-35, 42-45), and posctrl passes argv[1] to setTopics (src/posctrl.cpp:10-21). The G7 source checks pass with source_name robot_0 and type_ref src/MainController.cpp:29-30.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SURFACE: the clone creates only ROS publishers and subscribers. It registers no advertiseService, action server, dynamic_reconfigure server, pause, reset or stop endpoint. The follower loop has no ROS cancellation check and exits only when the distance is at most 0.3 m (src/PositionController.cpp:54-75). A zero-Twist publication on /robot_0/cmd_vel would be overwritten by the follower and proves only transmission; the only process stop is system(" killall stageros") in the generator's run branch (src/swarm_stage.cpp:421-425), which is not a ROS service or action. The package therefore leaves safety_bindings empty and declares no safe-state action instead of fabricating one; the runtime latches in software and reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED. G8 TCAP-003 also fails because a rosbridge topic publish returns only {published: true, confirmed: false}: the pinned follower sends no parse, motion, arrival or stop acknowledgement, so the extension output cannot vary with the target and the main resource is intentionally empty for an action-only driver. These are genuine upstream gaps, not fake defects.

LIMITS AND OVERLAY: the clone computes target poses from runtime formation and robot-count parameters and states no numeric arena or target-pose bound, so x and y are Limit.operator_required and every target is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until an operator supplies a site envelope. site-limits.example.json is an illustrative operator overlay only (example x/y -4..4 m), not a sourced device bound and not a Fact or Limit; the real deployment must replace it with measured arena bounds. The shipped 3/5/0.5 values and map size are configuration/layout defaults and are not copied into a Limit.

SCOPE AND FIDELITY: NOT COVERED: Stage physics, the external stage_ros/stageros node, /odom, /base_scan, /base_pose_ground_truth, /clock, TF, the other robot namespaces (robot_1 and robot_2), the formation controller, the fuzzy controller output, collision or arrival detection, live ROS, rosbridge, catkin_make and hardware. A live build also needs the ROS 1 turtlesim package: src/MainController.cpp:2 and src/posctrl.cpp:5 include turtlesim/Pose.h, but package.xml:51-66 and CMakeLists.txt:10-17 declare no turtlesim component; catkin_make was not run here. The built-in MainController publishes only when the requested robot count is at least four (its loops divide by four); with the shipped robots 3 and controller argument 3 it publishes no target, so the operator must publish the target or configure a handled count. This package binds only the explicit /robot_0 namespace because a RosDriver binding has one fixed endpoint. The fake is a ROS-free RecordingRosTransport, not a recording of captured traffic and not a physics stand-in: it records advertise and publish messages, records the last placeholder pose, and has a placeholder failure switch that raises on the next publish. It claims F0: engine analytic:ROS recording fake (no physics), determinism none, timestep_ms 0, realtime_factor 0, reset none, no snapshot/restore, and it runs no Stage world, posctrl follower or ROS graph. Its pose values are test data, not observations. No ROS graph, Stage process, hardware or live endpoint was contacted or validated; fake evidence is contract_checked only and does not establish a real ROS or hardware run.
